name: qualipulse-broken-link-checker
description: Find broken links on a public webpage with verified HTTP results.

interface.shortDescription: Find broken links on any page
interface.longDescription:
QualiPulse Broken Link Checker finds the broken links on any public webpage and backs every result with real HTTP evidence.

Ask ChatGPT to check a page and it will fetch the page, extract every link with its anchor text, and test each unique destination. A link is only reported as broken when the destination confirms it with HTTP 404 or 410. Links that are blocked, rate-limited, timing out or behind a login are reported separately, so you don't waste time fixing links that work for real visitors. Redirects are traced hop by hop so you can update links to their final URL.

Built for SEO specialists, website owners, content teams, developers and QA engineers.

Scope: one public page per request, up to 250 unique links. It does not crawl whole sites, log in to websites, or see links added by JavaScript, and every report states what was not covered.
defaultPrompt: Which links on my page are definitely broken? https://example.com/blog
List the links that redirect on https://example.com/resources so I can update them.

positive.description: Full link check of a page with known outcomes
positive.expected_behavior: Reports 2 broken links (/demo/missing returns 404, /demo/removed returns 410) with their anchor text, 1 redirected link (/demo/old-page to /demo/ok), and explains that the 403 and 500 links are not confirmed broken. Mailto and #top links are skipped.

positive.prompt: Which links on https://mcp.qualipulse.tech/demo are definitely broken? Leave out anything uncertain.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only the two links with HTTP 404 and 410 evidence and does not present the 403 or 500 links as broken.

positive.prompt: List the links on https://mcp.qualipulse.tech/demo that redirect, and where they end up.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies /demo/old-page as a 301 redirect to /demo/ok and suggests updating the link to the final URL.

positive.description: Real-world page with a link cap
positive.prompt: Check the first 20 links on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Link_rot.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs a scan with max_links 20, returns a partial report, and mentions that more links exist than were checked and that JavaScript-added links are not covered.

positive.prompt: List every link on https://mcp.qualipulse.tech/demo with its status, including the ones that work.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the scan with include_working enabled and lists all six unique destinations with their status, noting that the working link appears twice on the page.

negative.description: General SEO question that needs no scan
negative.prompt: What is a broken link and why does it matter for SEO?
Log in to my WordPress site and fix all the broken links for me.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: single-page broken link checks with HTTP evidence and redirect tracing.
